verification.npmTestEntrypoint: PASS from a clean copy of assets/eip-xxxx
verification.officialEipw0110Synthetic: PASS / 0 diagnostics / exit code 0, re-run on the current candidate
verification.eipwNegativeControl: PASS / breaking the CC0 sentence reproduces markdown-copyright, exit code 65
verification.proofPathAdversarialReview: COMPLETED / no exploitable defect; two architectural limits documented in the reference header
verification.noveltyIndependentAssessment: COMPLETED / nearest neighbour ERC-7965; novelty now rests on the projection invariants, not the proof
verification.reviewerPerspectiveBlocker: FIXED / holder cancellation gated on deadline; regression tests retained through the rewrite
verification.entitlementSemantics: ADR-006 perishable/deferrable taxonomy promoted to normative text
verification.registerProjectionAxiom: ADR-007 adopted; transfer blocking removed, strict monotonicity and commitment uniqueness added as invariants
verification.finalityRule: isFinalAsOf added; an instant is final iff it precedes the latest entry's effectiveAt, which follows from invariant 3
verification.deferredEntitlementRegistry: REMOVED by the author under ADR-009; holderAsOf and isFinalAsOf already let the owing contract bind the beneficiary itself, so the interface was convenience rather than capability and picked one policy for everyone
verification.discoverability: registerId and verificationProfile only; registerDescriptor removed by the author 2026-08-31 because a document URI cannot be verified on chain and the profile publishes one anyway. MAJOR-3 closed.
verification.confirmingEntries: same-holder expectedHolder now permitted; it is what makes instants final on a static holder
verification.hkexRuleConformanceAudit: COMPLETED / ex-entitlement misattribution corrected; H-1 (book closure) rejected by the author on the DAO-authority argument, see ADR-008
verification.perishableExerciseTrigger: FIXED / trigger restored from isFinalAsOf-false to contested (an open gap covering the instant); the broadened form would have forbidden DAO voting at almost every moment
verification.quiescence: ADDED / an interval with no gap open at its start and none begun in it cannot admit an entry, so governance can constitute a register closure with no new primitive; the act constituting it cannot be protected by it, so the contested rule is the floor (ADR-008 addendum)
verification.scopeDiscipline: ADR-009 applied / every normative statement tested against 'does it say who holds power, or what you must do'; the rights section went from 6 MUSTs to 2 and the spec from 34 to 30; no interface changed
verification.oracleBoundary: CORRECTED / the Motivation had framed oracles as a path this ERC escapes; it does not. A register without consensus needs an attesting party, its contents often cannot be published, and the proof verifies that party's committed statements. Normative load unchanged at 30 MUSTs; reference header comment only, runtime bytecode byte-identical.
verification.attestationVsVerification: CORRECTED / an earlier caution assumed an LLM extractor and is withdrawn; the profile definition no longer excludes constraining how a value is produced, since pinning a deterministic procedure is what makes a mechanical attester reproducible
verification.finalEditorialPass: COMPLETED 2026-08-31 / nine defects left by the edit rounds fixed in the spec, four in the Magicians post including a block lost to a range deletion, and the manual's Q&A rewritten to match the current design
verification.settlementWindow: H-5 CLOSED by the author 2026-08-31: an initiator-chosen deadline within the maximum is kept deliberately, since after the rewrite a gap affects neither trading nor finality. A deployment needing a fixed n constrains it in its profile.
verification.reviewerReviewPostRewrite: RESOLVED 2026-09-02 / BLOCKER-1 withdrawn: superseding requires owning the token, holding is not exercising, and the deferrable case has a retroactive claim path, so the griefing case is self-harm. MAJOR-2/3/4 and MINOR-5/6/7 fixed. The guidance paragraph was rewritten as explanation rather than deleted. DAO governance questions moved to issue #15.
verification.scopeCleanup: 2026-09-02 / material that accumulated while the discussion drifted was removed: three Rationale paragraphs on boards, electorates and the regress of constituting a closure; two on attester quality; the named term quiescent; and the closure question in the manual. What remains is the mapping and why a pending state exists. Interfaces untouched.
verification.rewriteAsFirstDraft: 2026-09-02 / the specification was written again from scratch rather than patched further. Settled decisions were held fixed and the two Solidity blocks were carried over byte-identically, so both interface ids are unchanged. The 39 MUST phrases in the old text and the new one form the same multiset: no normative content was lost or added. 5031 words to 4886.
verification.reviewOfTheRewrite: 2026-09-02 / SHOULD/MAY and the definition list were compared as well as MUSTs, then the text was read through. Four defects: snapshotHash was a bound leaf field with no definition anywhere, the same class as registryReference and missed when that one was fixed; the settlement period definition disagreed with both the accessor and beginSettlement and was never referenced; profile carried normative weight without being defined; one ambiguous antecedent. All fixed. Specification MUSTs 26 to 27.

userPrinciples.attestingPartyPreference: a deterministic rule-based AI oracle first (not an LLM), then human attestation under dual control, then existing oracles; a mechanical assertion always outranks a human one because it is reproducible, which dual control does not provide
userPrinciples.deferredEntitlementRegistry: ruled in on 2026-08-30, ruled out on 2026-08-31 under ADR-009: holderAsOf plus isFinalAsOf already let the owing contract bind the beneficiary, so the interface was convenience rather than capability and picked one policy for everyone
userPrinciples.registerClosure: not in this ERC. First judged to need an authority outside the register, then corrected — governance can derive it, and needs no new primitive — then removed entirely with the rest of the governance material as outside what this ERC does
